why_8108_interpretation_does_not_transfe.8108_reason: The earlier contextual proposal was limited to keys on the side of the complete retained LSIB 11.4 CHN-RUS line identified as Russia-facing by two retained State WorldPolygons anchors, and supported by bilateral 2008/2024 context.

PRC MFA 21 June 2024 boundary committee statement describes the border as clear and stable and records the committee mechanism; it is not a key- or segment-specific coordinate validation.

next_lawful_evidence_step.step: Use the specifically identified official documentary leads: seek a public copy/catalogue entry for the joint-inspection protocol, attached maps and boundary-marker register described in the PRC 2016 joint statement, and/or the 2008 eastern-section supplementary descriptive protocol annex. If found, bind its named sectors/markers to the four exact CHN ADM1 contact groups and the 79 water-labelled keys; prioritize the 205 farther-than-100m descriptive stratum while preserving all 872 as held pending evidence.
next_lawful_evidence_step.reason: The 2016 official statement establishes that maps and a marker register were produced and identifies the relevant 2008 segment, but its public page does not contain the attachments or a tuple-to-sector link. The next step is now a specific document retrieval/catalogue check, not a speculative broad map search.
next_lawful_evidence_step.scope_limit: This is a finite segment-level follow-up, not a universal modern-boundary certificate, a demand for a new world geometry corpus, or a promise that an annex exists or will resolve every key.

official_results_opened.title: PRC-Russia agreement on management of the state boundary (official MFA PDF, 28 pages)
official_results_opened.finding: The agreement was signed in Beijing on 9 November 2006 (closing text, page 15). Article 53 says it takes effect 30 days after the last written notice, but the body does not give that notice date, so this PDF alone does not establish the actual effective date. Its preamble says it replaces the agreement signed 27 May 1994. Page 1, Article 2 lists the 14 October 2004 eastern-boundary supplementary agreement among delimitation instruments. Pages 1–2, Articles 3 and 7(4) state the role of effective joint-inspection protocols as supplements to demarcation documents; no sector/marker values or tuple correspondence are given.

protocol_annex_search.implication: The Sapporo official communiqué is the clearest public catalogue-like record encountered: it names the signed 2016 inspection protocol, but its attachment section is blank. The 2016 statement identifies maps and marker registers as produced; the opened pages do not expose them. No defensible 872-key-to-sector/marker linkage follows from these records.
